info.description: This is the API documentation for the Cartify Platform, an e-commerce solution built with Go, Gin, and PostgreSQL. It provides endpoints for user management, product catalog, order processing, and more.
info.title: Cartify Platform API

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password to receive JWT access and refresh tokens.

200.description: Successfully authenticated. Returns access_token and refresh_token.

400.description: Invalid request payload or validation error.

post.description: Generate a new access token using a valid refresh token.

400.description: Invalid refresh token or request payload.

post.description: Create a new user account with first name, last name, email, and password.

400.description: Validation error or user already exists.

get.description: Retrieve all items in the currently authenticated user's cart.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

delete.description: Delete all items from the authenticated user's cart.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

put.description: Set the exact quantity of a product in the authenticated user's cart.

200.description: Successfully updated item, returns updated cart.

400.description: Invalid request payload or validation error.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

post.description: Add a product to the authenticated user's cart (increments quantity if already in cart).

200.description: Successfully added item, returns updated cart.

400.description: Invalid request payload or validation error.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

delete.description: Remove a product completely from the authenticated user's cart.

200.description: Successfully removed item, returns updated cart.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

get.description: Retrieve a list of paginated orders for the authenticated user.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

post.description: Checkout the items in the cart and create a pending order.

400.description: Invalid request payload or empty cart.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all orders.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific order.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

403.description: Forbidden: Not allowed to access this order.

put.description: Cancel a pending or processing order.

400.description: Invalid order ID format or cannot cancel.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

403.description: Forbidden: Not authorized to cancel this order.

put.description: Update the status of an order.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all registered users. This endpoint is restricted to administrators.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

delete.description: Permanently remove the currently authenticated user's account from the system.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

500.description: Internal server error during account deletion.

get.description: Retrieve the detailed profile information of the currently authenticated user.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

patch.description: Modify the personal details (first name, last name) of the currently authenticated user.

400.description: Invalid request payload or validation error.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

post.description: Update the password for the currently authenticated user. Requires verifying the old password.

400.description: Validation error or incorrect old password.

401.description: Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication token.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer " followed by a space and then your token. For example: "Bearer eyJhbGci..."
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
